projectDescription: OneRep is an all-in-one fitness app that combines training, nutrition, recovery, and progress tracking with an AI Coach — available on web, iOS, and Android.
keyFeatures: Daily dashboard with calorie and macro rings, meals, water, supplements, and configurable widgets
Training with exercise catalog, workout templates, weekly routines, rest timers, and volume trends
Nutrition with food search (USDA, Open Food Facts), barcode scanning, meal presets, recipes, and quick-log
Progress with body measurements, body-fat check-ins, charts, and custom metrics
AI Coach with text, voice, and image input across Briefing, Nutrition, and Training modes
Snap & Log photo food detection with a review step before anything is logged
Bring-your-own OpenRouter key for AI Coach running entirely on your credential
REST API and MCP endpoint on user-minted keys so scripts and assistants read the same log
Self-hosting via a single Docker Compose install script
Full data export and account deletion; analytics opt-in off by default
iOS and Android apps (Capacitor) plus installable PWA from the same React codebase
publicApiSurface: GET /v1 — route list filtered to the key's scopes
GET /v1/me — key scopes and hourly rate-limit budget
GET /v1/goals — calorie and macro targets, water goal, weight unit, stated goal
GET /v1/insights — progression verdicts, recovery vs baseline, monthly summaries
GET /v1/days/{date} — everything logged on one date
GET /v1/days?start=&end= — per-day totals over a date range
POST /v1/water — log a drink { amountMl, date? }
POST /v1/food — log a food entry { name, calories, protein?, carbs?, fat?, meal?, date? }
POST /v1/weight — record a weigh-in { weightKg, date? }
POST /v1/workouts — record a workout { exercises, durationMinutes?, date? }
